question: Who among the following is a famous performer of Kalbelia dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Gulabo Sapera__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gulabo Sapera is a renowned performer of the **Kalbelia dance**, which is a traditional folk dance of Rajasthan.
 
• This **dance form is associated with the Kalbelia community,** known for their nomadic lifestyle and expertise in snake charming.g
 
• The Kalbelia dance was inscribed in UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in **2010**, highlighting its cultural significance and the efforts of performers like Gulabo Sapera in preserving this vibrant art form.
 
• Gulabo Sapera received the **Padma Shri** in **2016** for her contributions to Indian art and culture, marking a significant achievement for folk artists.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Minati Mishra**

 
 
• **​**Minati Mishra **was an Indian classical dancer** and actress, known for her expertise in the Indian classical dance form of Odissi.
 
• She** was reported in 2011 to be the oldest-living Odissi performe**r.
 
• The Government of India honored in 2012, with the fourth-highest civilian award of Padma Shri.
 
 
 
• **Geeta Mahalik**
 
 
• **​**Geeta Mahalik (born 1948) **is an Indian Odissi dancer.**
 
• The **Government of India honoured her with the Padma Shri in 2014 f**or her services to the field of art and culture
 
• Gita Mahalik began her training at a very early age from renowned guru, Deba Prasad Dash.
 
 
 
• **Vyjayanthi Kashi**
 
 
• **​**Vyjayanthi Kashi** is a reputed kuchipudi dancer, **a celebrated performer and choreographer and artistic director of a dance school Shambhavi School of Dance where they teaches this traditional dance form kuchipudi.
 
• She was also the c**hairperson of Karnataka Sangeetha Nritya Academy.**
 
 

31:T
